speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the history; given your age and the 3-week progression of headache with worsening vision, is the pain located behind one of your eyes or at the top of your head, and does it worsen when you bend forward?

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Giant Cell Arteritis (Temporal Arteritis).

The combination of age (69), new-onset headache, and progressive vision loss over three weeks is highly specific for this condition, which requires immediate treatment to prevent permanent blindness. I will now confirm if you have noticed any jaw pain while chewing or scalp tenderness before proceeding to urgent blood work.
